name: poly_flt_noncoprime_proportional
statement: {k : Type*} [Field k] [DecidableEq k] [CharZero k] (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (a b c : Polynomial k) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) (heq : a ^ n + b ^ n = c ^ n) : ∃ (d : Polynomial k) (α β γ : k), a = Polynomial.C α * d ∧ b = Polynomial.C β * d ∧ c = Polynomial.C γ * d
closed: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] [DecidableEq k] [CharZero k] (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (a b c : Polynomial k) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) (heq : a ^ n + b ^ n = c ^ n), ∃ (d : Polynomial k) (α β γ : k), a = Polynomial.C α * d ∧ b = Polynomial.C β * d ∧ c = Polynomial.C γ * d
informal: FLT for polynomials without coprimality: in char 0, any nonzero solution of a^n + b^n = c^n (n ≥ 3) is a common polynomial d times a constant solution — take d = gcd(a,b); d^n ∣ c^n gives d ∣ c; the quotients are pairwise coprime and satisfy the same equation, so Uses Mathlib2.ms_flt_poly to make them constants.
type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] [DecidableEq k] [CharZero k] (n : ℕ), 3 ≤ n → ∀ (a b c : Polynomial k), a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → c ≠ 0 → a ^ n + b ^ n = c ^ n → ∃ d α β γ, a = Polynomial.C α * d ∧ b = Polynomial.C β * d ∧ c = Polynomial.C γ * d
